flora: Stunted Araucaria trees in the background
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded, expressive features; tactile, 'pebbly' scale texture; emphasis on the snake's thick, powerful body; background features purple-tinged mudstone.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle close-up of the Dinilysia slithering over a mudstone ridge. The snake’s head is slightly raised, tongue flicking. In the foreground, a broken geode reveals sparkling crystals, a hallmark of the Anacleto geology.
visual_logic.ground: Cracked purple-red claystone mixed with fine ochre silt; sparse clusters of ancient ferns.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct cinematic sunlight creating high-contrast shadows that accentuate the snake's muscular form.
